scope: Exact independent V4 candidate review, not formal enablement or exam-provenance certification

rules.title: 考试用途明确
rules.requirement: 回答“考生在哪类公考作答步骤会用到这条记忆”；泛化的好习惯、教学标签或字面释义不能代替用途。

rules.title: 主归属准确
rules.requirement: 考试模块、子专题、具体目标分别登记；来源目录不是主归属充分证据。

rules.title: 记忆目标具体
rules.requirement: 记录可直接调用的概念边界、公式、逻辑变换、口诀展开、触发条件或关键步骤；说明遗忘或混淆如何影响解题。

rules.title: 考察与目标一致
rules.requirement: 题目正确选项必须命中所登记目标，不能挂比例论证却只考一般分数分母。

rules.title: 表达独立清楚
rules.requirement: 题干与选项、解析不以“笔记说／笔记要求／本节介绍”为权威，不复述未展开的教学标签；来源留在引用字段与查阅入口。

rules.title: 干扰真实可辨
rules.requirement: 干扰来自同一目标下的实际误用、反向、条件漏项或相邻概念，不能混入无关领域或靠荒谬表述送分。

rules.title: 形式服务目标
rules.requirement: 基础不计算、不塞完整故事；方法以区别、识别或某一步决策为终点；应用保留原完整任务，不按三入口硬配额。

rules.title: 口诀可展开且有边界
rules.requirement: 口诀绑定每字实际含义及可提示的观察方向，不只考谐音拼写；“考虑／优先”不能变成唯一或必然规律。

rules.title: 来源与答案有效
rules.requirement: 逐项核源、必要条件、唯一答案、图片完整性和暴露；块哈希正确不等于语义正确。

rules.title: 审核事实独立
rules.requirement: 自动结构、语义专家判断、用户方向认可、正式内容批准分别记录；不把review候选和source点数量充作合格覆盖。

ruleEvaluation.conditionalNotApplicable: EXAM-08可为not-applicable，须记录不涉及口诀的理由；通用规则不可not-applicable。
ruleEvaluation.admission: 全部适用项pass，且没有fail/hold，审核依赖仍有效；结构齐全不推导语义pass。

targetExtension.ownership: subjectId/categoryId remain the primary exam module/topic; sourceBindings keep original source identity; aliases must resolve to these fields, not parallel independent primaryExamModuleId values.
targetExtension.nonPracticeDisposition: source-level inventory records framework/explanation/relationship-only content separately; no empty target or fake question required.

semanticReceiptContract.storage: append-only separate offline review ledger; compiler emits resolved validation facts, runtime never trusts author booleans

reviewer.scope: one primary module ID, module/topic, or all-five-modules; compiler/runtime verify scope matches the reviewed question
reviewer.independence: 独立评审阶段，不能沿用生成器自评；agent复核记录任务身份与证据，不冒充人工专家或正式批准。

questionBinding.digestStage: after original-task resolution, neutral display completion and asset resolution

resolvedDependencyManifest.eachEntry: Referenced versioned entity (question/target/atom/comparison/material/shared binding): stable identity + its substantive revision + SHA-256. Unversioned source tab/block or image: exact stable identity + raw source/asset digest, revision=null; never invent a source revision. Inapplicable collections [] or object null with reason.
resolvedDependencyManifest.source: preserve subjectId/pointId/tabId/block anchor, existing expectedSha256 and expectedBlockSha256; image dependencies include actual asset bytes digest or unresolved hold

semanticReceiptContract.decisionSelection: append-only chain per question; supersedes previous receipt; fork/conflicting heads -> hold until explicit resolution; latest effective head controls, never search old accept receipts to override rewrite/drop/hold
semanticReceiptContract.invalidation: question effective content, target substantive fields, referenced atoms/comparisons/source or shared binding digest, or applicable ruleVersion changed -> stale; no V4 admission until new receipt
semanticReceiptContract.formalApproval: accept-candidate retains status review; approved and its existing proof/dependencies are separately required outside develop; a stale semantic receipt removes eligibility even if approved is still stored.
semanticReceiptContract.ruleDigest: SHA-256 over canonical substantive rules/applicability and target/review/digest/session contracts; binds content even when a version label is mistakenly reused. Exclude document status/date and typography.
semanticReceiptContract.legacyApplicationFormalGate: All current 15 applications are legacy-unverified; keep existing compiler rejection of approved. Semantic acceptance can admit review in develop only. Verify source nature/task/answer and any exam provenance separately; never flip sourceKind merely to bypass this gate.
semanticReceiptContract.receiptChain: First receipt supersedesReceiptId=null; later receipt must reference an existing current head for same question. Concurrent or conflicting heads -> hold until explicit reconciliation; preserve every previous record.
semanticReceiptContract.authorId: Generation author/task identity, distinct from independent review task identity; unknown legacy authorship must be recorded as unknown, never as verified person.
semanticReceiptContract.conflictResolution: An explicit appended receipt may supersede one head and list the other current conflicting head IDs in resolvesReceiptIds; same-question identity, acyclic graph and one resulting head required; never overwrite prior records.
semanticReceiptContract.rejectedOrHeldDependencies: A rewrite/drop/hold receipt may preserve an explicitly incomplete dependency manifest with resolutionState=incomplete-not-eligible and unresolvedDependencies, alongside exact question/version and known dependency digests. It can never admit content: accept-candidate requires a fresh, fully resolved binding computed by bindingFor; changing only the decision fails exact-manifest and rule checks.

digestContract.algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON, semantic-manifest-v1: recursively sort object keys by code-unit order, retain array order and exact strings (no whitespace or Unicode normalization), finite numbers use JSON.stringify representation, reject undefined/non-finite values/sparse arrays instead of silently dropping them; freeze canonical-byte and digest fixtures.
effectiveQuestionIncludes: images and resolved asset content hashes
dependencyIncludes: resolved primary AND supporting target semantic revision/statement/conclusion/conditions/excludes/exam-use/answer-core/confusions
excludedOnly: entry ordering unrelated to frozen task
digestContract.displayEdit: Only separate whitelisted fields; do not call source-body edits display-only; existing source full-tab/block validation remains strict. Existing revision is substantive by default; display metadata uses separate revision and cannot silently bypass old version checks.
digestContract.unresolvedDependency: hold; never hash an absent source into valid semantics
digestContract.reuse: leave existing approvalDigest and source hashing intact; new semantic/dependency proof supplements them; package version is not a blanket session expiry key

admissionMatrix.lifecycle: approved, valid existing approval and all approved dependencies; legacy-unverified remains forbidden by existing compiler

sessionContract.newInstances: freeze resolved primary/supporting target semantic snapshots OR full versioned dependency manifest with immutable hashes, plus effective semantic signature and source links; independent of author self-declaration
sessionContract.runtimeValidation: eligibility current AND semantic dependency signature current; receipt timestamps/renewal for identical semantics alone do not expire a group; a changed effective decision does
sessionContract.substantiveChange: expire only active groups containing affected question/target/atom/comparison/source/binding/material/image; no automatic regeneration/auto-submit/regrade
sessionContract.historicalMigration: old instances lacking dependency manifest must prove compatibility against frozen baseline and current valid semantic acceptance; otherwise expire affected active session, keep past answers; no grandfathering all original applications or adding missing target proof by assumption
sessionContract.withdrawal: unselected/rejected/held question cannot start, resume or submit in active group; do not erase old session/attempt merely to enforce withdrawal
sessionContract.materialGroups: all required siblings and material eligible together; if one is held, hold that whole dependent application group and report counts

sharedSourceContract.compiler: explicit allowlist only, do not remove subject/category/anchor checks globally
checks: no duplicated resources across scope unions
sharedSourceContract.mnemonicAmbiguity: 屈臣氏整风/整形 and 氏↔样式规律 mapping unresolved -> hold only affected goals
sharedSourceContract.bindingDigestProjection: hash id/revision/primary module-topic/exact original source identity/allowed targets/evidence source anchors and original source digests only; exclude bindingDigest itself and reviewReceiptId/receipt metadata to avoid self-reference and circular approval dependencies. Validate linked receipt separately.
sharedSourceContract.bindingLifecycle: status review/approved/blocked; current validated source-binding receipt needed for develop; non-development also requires approved binding with existing-style manual approval of bindingDigest.
sharedSourceContract.reviewLedger: sourceBindingReviews is an append-only audit fact array beside question receipts; unique current accepted head must equal binding.reviewReceiptId; ancestry and conflict checks shared with question receipts, optional explicit resolvesReceiptIds retains history.

legacyTransitionContract.archive: Legacy questions/targets and historical records may remain archived with old fields; absence of a V4 review is an exclusion reason, never an invented accept or a demand to fabricate reviews for all64 first.
legacyTransitionContract.EV0A: Remove 7 rejected current forms from all entryPlans; keep raw records and frozen attempts.
legacyTransitionContract.EV0B: When switching the sole active entryPlans to V4, remove all remaining not-yet-accepted legacy IDs from the plans; frozen baseline ledger retains old membership. Runtime also fails closed. No parallel live legacy entry for unreviewed questions.
legacyTransitionContract.compile: Only admit V4-selected resources meeting new target/review/dependency requirements; archive migration validation remains explicit. A selected invalid resource fails the active build; an unselected pending archive is not promoted and need not block independently reviewed modules.
legacyTransitionContract.emptyState: Before first real module acceptance, V4 may have zero available practice; show browse-all-notes link, no fallback to rejected or unreviewed old questions.

reviewSlicePolicy.atomicMaterialGroupException: A single indivisible same-module material group may exceed 12; record groupId, count and reason, keep one receipt per question, no unrelated questions in slice.

items.title: 环形跑道两次追及

distractorReasons.B: 第一次甲乙路程差为180米，不是150米。

originTask.statement: 一条圆形跑道长 500 米，甲、乙两人从不同起点同时出发，均沿顺时针方向匀速跑步。已知甲跑了 600 米后第一次追上乙，此后甲加速 20% 继续前进，又跑了 1200 米后第二次追上乙。问甲出发后多少米第一次到达乙的出发点？

items.title: 顺逆扶梯的静态级数

distractorReasons.B: 忽略逆行用时是顺行的3倍会误得40。

originTask.statement: 同一自动扶梯恒速向上运行，某人相对梯面的行走速度恒定，且大于扶梯运行速度。他顺行向上走20级到达楼上，逆行向下走60级到达楼下。每步跨一级，扶梯两端之间的静态长度不变，问扶梯可见级数为多少级？

items.title: 火车完全过桥
